Belmonte Lorna 

Hi! 😊

We were on a B/1 visa for 2 years and then on an A/5 visa for another 3 years and 9 months.

In our last year on the A/5 visa, I emailed to book an appointment and mentioned that I wanted to apply for citizenship. The officer then sent me a list of the documents I needed to bring.
